title: Finish this sentence: “If nothing stopped me, this year I'd…”
why: Imagining your best possible future makes it feel more reachable.

title: Spend 20 minutes on something you loved as a kid. Rate your energy after, 1 to 5.
why: Old loves are clues to what still lights you up.

title: Pick one value, like curiosity, courage or kindness, and do one thing today that shows it.
why: Living by your values, in small acts, is what makes a life feel meaningful.

title: Do the first lesson of a skill you keep saying you'll learn.
why: Starting is the hardest part, and one lesson is a real start.

title: Make something and show one person: a page, a sketch, a recipe, a song.
why: Sharing what you make turns a hobby into a thread of meaning.

title: Decide when and where you'll do your next Purpose quest: “At [time] in [place], I will…”
